identity_exclusions: Roy Chambers Homestead structures south of Ditch Creek
acquisition_rules: Download only selected HABS sheets and reference-sized images required by the worker; do not mirror complete collections.
Record the resolved download URL, retrieval date, item-level credit, licence and SHA-256 before using a local file.
A page-level source record is not sufficient permission to redistribute an embedded third-party image.
known_uncertainties: The HABS catalogue coordinate is a search seed, not a surveyed cluster anchor.

The NPS visitor narrative loosely associates a 1946 windmill with the Chambers homestead, while the National Register description labels a contributing 1946 windmill in the adjacent Roy Chambers complex; placement must be resolved from the site map and field evidence.
The current condition of openings and fabric may differ from the HABS and National Register documentation.
